snippet.title: Bottled By Bears - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Our first game, it's called Bottled by Bears! 🐻🐝

Join a family of bears and run the buzziest little honey farm! Collect and discover rare bees, bottle honey jars, expand your farm, and watch your flowery field bloom in this cozy idle management game.

Wishlist on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4390080/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=social&utm_content=ann_trailer

Music by @samanthavandersluis
